label: Federal rescheduling
note: DEA issued its first federal registrations to 900+ medical dispensaries in AL, FL, MS, SD, TX, VA and WV (Oct 30); manufacturer and distributor applications still under review. Full rescheduling still stayed: GAO-report briefs filed Oct 29 (DEA asked the judge to give the report no weight); optional replies due Nov 5, then the judge prepares a recommended decision
source: Marijuana Moment (DOJ release and DEA ALJ briefing, Oct 30)
